nodes.description: ERC20 private mapping (address => uint256) holding token balances of accounts.
ERC20 private nested mapping (address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding spend allowances.
ERC20 private uint256 total token supply.
ERC20 private string token name, set once in constructor.
ERC20 private string token symbol, set once in constructor.
GeneratorCopyright private string generator version, set in constructor.
GeneratorCopyright private constant string generator URL.
SimpleERC20 payable constructor: validates initialBalance_ > 0 and mints initial supply to _msgSender().
ERC20 internal _mint(account, amount): increases _totalSupply and _balances[account], emits Transfer.
ERC20 internal _transfer(sender, recipient, amount): moves balances and emits Transfer.
ERC20 internal _approve(owner, spender, amount): writes _allowances and emits Approval.
ERC20 public transfer(recipient, amount): calls _transfer with _msgSender().
ERC20 public transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount): checks allowance and decreases it before/while moving tokens.
ERC20 public approve(spender, amount): calls _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
ERC20 public increaseAllowance(spender, addedValue): adds to existing allowance via _approve.
ERC20 public decreaseAllowance(spender, subtractedValue): subtracts from allowance after a require check.
ERC20 internal _burn(account, amount): decreases _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
ServicePayer payable constructor: forwards msg.value to the receiver by calling pay().
Context internal _msgSender() returning msg.sender as the execution context sender.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller address, used as owner/recipient/spender across the token.
External call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed in ServicePayer constructor with an attacker-supplied receiver address.
Constructor string parameter name_ assigned to _name.
Constructor string parameter symbol_ assigned to _symbol.
Constructor uint256 initialBalance_ minted to the deployer, required to be > 0.
Constructor address payable feeReceiver_ used as the callee of the external pay() call.
uint256 amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom/_mint/_burn controlling value moved.
address recipient parameter of transfer/transferFrom receiving tokens.
address sender parameter of transferFrom/_transfer whose balance is debited.
address spender parameter of approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance receiving allowance.
address account parameter of _mint/_burn whose balance is credited or debited.
Local uint256 in transferFrom/decreaseAllowance caching _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].
Local uint256 in _transfer caching _balances[sender] before writing.

edges.reason: _msgSender() returns msg.sender, propagating caller-controlled data into the context.
msg.sender (via _msgSender()) is passed as the account argument of _mint in the constructor.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the debit address.
transferFrom reads and updates the allowance keyed by _msgSender().
approve uses _msgSender() as the owner of the allowance.
name_ constructor argument flows into the _name state variable.
symbol_ constructor argument flows into the _symbol state variable.
initialBalance_ is validated (> 0) and used as the mint amount.
feeReceiver_ is forwarded to ServicePayer and becomes the external callee.
Attacker-influenced feeReceiver_ is cast to IPayable and becomes the target of the external pay() call.
ServicePayer constructor executes the external pay() call during construction.
The external callee invoked during construction can call back into the freshly deployed contract before the mint state is settled.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes _mint for the initial supply.
initialBalance_ argument is passed into _mint as the amount.
initialBalance_ value flows to the minted amount written into _balances and _totalSupply.
_mint writes _balances[account] += amount.
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrease the remaining allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve with the summed value.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve with the subtracted value.
increaseAllowance writes _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] using _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue (checked arithmetic in 0.8).
_transfer debits _balances[sender] and credits _balances[recipient] (checked arithmetic in 0.8).
_transfer reads _balances[sender] into the senderBalance local.
_burn decreases _balances[account] by amount.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by amount.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances[owner][spender].
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] to validate the spend.
decreaseAllowance reads the current allowance before subtracting.
amount parameter determines the value moved in _transfer.
recipient parameter becomes the credited balance key in _transfer.
sender parameter becomes the debited balance key in _transfer.
spender parameter is the allowance key written by _approve.
account parameter is the balance key credited by _mint.
currentAllowance local is passed to _approve as the new allowance value.
senderBalance local is written back into _balances[sender] in _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor string parameter name_ has no independent security meaning; it is absorbed into the SimpleERC20 constructor that assigns it to _name.
Constructor string parameter symbol_ is only used by the SimpleERC20 constructor to set _symbol.
initialBalance_ is the mint amount and is directly consumed by the _mint core operation.
feeReceiver_ is the attacker-influenceable callee of the unsafe external pay() call and is subsumed by that unsafe_operation.
amount is the value moved by the _transfer core operation.
recipient is the credited address handled inside _transfer.
sender is the debited address handled inside _transfer.
spender is the allowance key handled inside the _approve core operation.
account is the credited address handled inside the _mint core operation.
currentAllowance is a transient local feeding _approve's amount argument.
senderBalance is a transient local read from and written back to _balances inside _transfer.
